_note: Opel arrived with the generation code still attached: 'Astra H OPC' and 'Corsa D OPC' name a specific platform generation, which is not something a seller picks. Worse, the base cars were missing entirely - there was an 'Astra H OPC' row but no 'Astra', so an ordinary Astra could not be listed at all. Adds the four base models and moves OPC to where it belongs, as a variant. Two generations of the same car collapse onto one OPC variant, which is the point: both keep an alias, the dropdown shows one entry.
